Fourth exhaustion. 12 additional variants (v049-v060) tested on new BM25 infra. Best average: v039 at 71.11%. Best single-run: v032 at 72.33%. All variants oscillate 70-72.33% due to BM25 retrieval nondeterminism (~2pp variance). The 72.5% target is 0.17pp above our best single run. Cannot be reliably achieved with prompt-only changes. Root cause: BM25 retrieval variance creates 36 volatile cases that flip randomly. Reaching 72.5% reliably requires parameter changes (retrieval_k increase, temperature reduction) or structural changes (retry/verification steps) — all outside scope.
